descriptor: Small-batch coffee roasted in a stone barn

voice.summary: Sounds like a roaster talking over the counter: slow, sensory, proud of the farms. Sentences are short and dated by the week, not the year.
dos: Describe taste with one concrete comparison
State roast and post days plainly

taglines: Roasted twice a week, posted fresh
boilerplate: Obsidian & Oat is a small coffee roastery that buys from four farms it has visited, roasts twice a week in a stone barn and posts orders the same morning.

microcopy.success: You're on the list, expect a note on Thursday
microcopy.error: That email did not go through, try again
microcopy.empty: No beans in your basket yet

logo.note: A flame represents the roast, the thing the brand does slowly and well.
